title: Heated Stadium Poncho – Three Heat Settings via USB
seo_description: Knitted heated poncho in beige with front zipper and three heat settings. Powered via USB from a power bank (not included).
descriptionHtml:
The cold sets in as soon as you stop moving

Sitting still in the stands or in the hunting stand makes the body stop producing its own heat, and the cold takes over within minutes. You already have your thickest jacket on, but sitting still means it isn't enough.

A poncho with three heat settings you control yourself

The poncho is knitted in beige, opens and closes with a zipper straight down the front, and is powered via USB from a power bank. Three heat settings let you choose how much warmth you want.

Features

  • Keeps the heat going when you sit still – three heat settings built in
  • On and off like an ordinary jacket – zipper straight down the front
  • Powered by a power bank you already have – connects via USB
  • Knitted fabric in beige – looks like an ordinary poncho, not a technical gadget

Power bank not included.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
